// Built only by test-seamless-reconnect.py, alongside the normal game-demo wire client.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"MMO_MODULE/game/clientsync"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/cellworld"
	fredis "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis"
	redisdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis/driver"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/versionstore"
)

var (
	reconnectRedis = flag.String("redis", "", "private Redis with this run's grants")
	reconnectWorld = flag.String("world", "", "unique partition world of this run")
	reconnectGrace = flag.Duration("grace", 8*time.Second, "configured reconnect grace")
	wirePath       = flag.String("wire-trace", "", "JSONL of all decoded sync frames (all sockets)")
)

func init() { reconnectDrill = runReconnect }

type frameBook struct {
	refs map[frame.ObjectRef]int64
	full map[int64]map[string]any
}

// Independently track references: the gameplay client's held[subject] would otherwise hide two
// wire objects representing the same avatar. On Full, rebuild exactly what that packet contains.
type frameAudit struct {
	sync.Mutex
	out        *json.Encoder
	books      map[*client]*frameBook
	watched    int64
	continuous bool
}

func (a *frameAudit) frame(c *client, at time.Time, f entitysync.ReceivedFrame) error {
	a.Lock()
	defer a.Unlock()
	b := a.books[c]
	if b == nil {
		b = &frameBook{refs: map[frame.ObjectRef]int64{}, full: map[int64]map[string]any{}}
		a.books[c] = b
	}
	if f.Kind == frame.Full {
		b.refs = map[frame.ObjectRef]int64{}
	}
	var ops []map[string]any
	var illegal string
	for _, o := range f.Objects {
		fields := map[string]any{}
		full := false
		for _, comp := range o.Components {
			u := comp.Update
			if len(u.Payload.BytesCopy()) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			doc, err := clientsync.DecodeFields(u)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for k, v := range doc {
				fields[k] = v
			}
			full = full || u.Full
		}
		ops = append(ops, map[string]any{"ref": o.Ref, "subject": o.SubjectID, "op": o.Operation, "full_component": full, "fields": fields})
		switch o.Operation {
		case frame.ObjectCreate:
			b.refs[o.Ref] = o.SubjectID
			if full && !c.readySent.IsZero() && !at.Before(c.readySent) {
				b.full[o.SubjectID] = fields
			}
		case frame.ObjectRemove:
			delete(b.refs, o.Ref)
		}
		if a.continuous && c.name == "B" && o.SubjectID == a.watched && (o.Operation == frame.ObjectCreate || o.Operation == frame.ObjectRemove) {
			illegal = fmt.Sprintf("B received operation %v for retained actor %d", o.Operation, o.SubjectID)
		}
	}
	n := 0
	for _, id := range b.refs {
		if id == a.watched {
			n++
		}
	}
	if err := a.out.Encode(map[string]any{"at": at.UTC(), "socket": c.name, "ready_sent": c.readySent.UTC(), "stream": f.StreamID, "epoch": f.Epoch, "tick": f.Tick, "base_tick": f.BaseTick, "kind": f.Kind, "ops": ops, "tracked_actor": a.watched, "tracked_refs": n}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if a.continuous && c.name == "B" && n != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("B now holds %d references to retained actor %d", n, a.watched)
	}
	if illegal != "" {
		return errors.New(illegal)
	}
	return nil
}
func (a *frameAudit) snapshots(c *client, ids ...int64) (map[int64]map[string]any, bool) {
	a.Lock()
	defer a.Unlock()
	out := map[int64]map[string]any{}
	b := a.books[c]
	if b == nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	for _, id := range ids {
		f := b.full[id]
		if len(f) == 0 {
			return out, false
		}
		out[id] = f
	}
	return out, true
}
func (a *frameAudit) watch(id int64, on bool) {
	a.Lock()
	defer a.Unlock()
	a.watched = id
	a.continuous = on
}
func health(c *client) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.failure != nil {
		return c.failure
	}
	if c.closed {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s TCP unexpectedly closed", c.name)
	}
	return nil
}
func (c *client) actor() int64 { c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock(); return c.actorID }
func frameCount(c *client) int { c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock(); return c.frames }
func presentOn(ctx context.Context, c *client, id int64, test func(object) bool) error {
	return waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "wire actor on "+c.name, func() (bool, string) {
		o, ok := c.snapshot()[id]
		return ok && test(o), fmt.Sprintf("actor=%d at=%v hp=%d err=%v", id, o.pos(), o.hp(), health(c))
	})
}
func fullReady(ctx context.Context, a *frameAudit, c, b *client, actor, other int64) error {
	var fields map[int64]map[string]any
	err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "post-Ready full creates (self player, avatar, observer)", func() (bool, string) {
		p, ok := c.ownPlayer()
		if !ok {
			return false, "no self Player: " + c.describe()
		}
		var base int64
		for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
			if o.ns == p.ns && o.ns == "player" && entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id) != kindCellPlayer && entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(id) == c.playerID {
				base = id
				break
			}
		}
		var all bool
		fields, all = a.snapshots(c, base, actor, other)
		if _, ok := clientsync.PlayerExp(fields[base]); !ok {
			return false, "self Player create has no profile"
		}
		if !all || len(fields) != 3 {
			return false, fmt.Sprintf("missing full creates, base %d actor %d observer %d; held %s", base, actor, other, c.describe())
		}
		for _, id := range []int64{actor, other} {
			f := fields[id]
			if _, ok := f["pos_x"]; !ok {
				return false, fmt.Sprint(f)
			}
			if _, ok := f["pos_y"]; !ok {
				return false, fmt.Sprint(f)
			}
			if (object{fields: f}).hp() <= 0 {
				return false, fmt.Sprint(f)
			}
		}
		return c.actor() == actor && b.actor() == other, fmt.Sprint(fields)
	})
	if err == nil {
		step("ready_full_"+c.name, map[string]any{"at": time.Now().UTC(), "full_creates": fields, "frames": frameCount(c)})
	}
	return err
}

func runReconnect(ctx context.Context) error {
	wire, err := os.OpenFile(*wirePath, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer wire.Close()
	audit := &frameAudit{books: map[*client]*frameBook{}, out: json.NewEncoder(wire)}
	observeDecoded = audit.frame
	redis, err := redisdriver.NewClient(fredis.DefaultConfig(*reconnectRedis))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer redis.Close()
	store, err := versionstore.NewRedisStore(redis, versionstore.RedisConfig[int64, cellworld.OwnerRecord]{Prefix: "roost:cellworld:" + *reconnectWorld + ":owner:", KeyOf: func(i int64) string { return strconv.FormatInt(i, 10) }, Codec: versionstore.JSONCodec[cellworld.OwnerRecord]{}})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	acct, done, err := accounts()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer done()
	nonce := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano()%1000000000, 36)
	dial := func(role, label string) (*client, error) { return loginSocket(ctx, acct, role, 1000, nonce, label) }
	b, err := dial("observer", "B")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer b.raw.Close()
	a, err := dial("walker", "A1")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer a.raw.Close()
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 6*time.Second, "two distinct avatars visible on both TCP sockets", func() (bool, string) {
		aid, bid := a.actor(), b.actor()
		_, ab := a.snapshot()[bid]
		_, ba := b.snapshot()[aid]
		return aid != 0 && bid != 0 && aid != bid && ab && ba, fmt.Sprintf("A=%s B=%s", a.describe(), b.describe())
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	actor, bid := a.actor(), b.actor()
	audit.watch(actor, true)
	read := func() (cellworld.OwnerRecord, error) {
		v, ok, e := store.Get(ctx, actor)
		if e != nil {
			return cellworld.OwnerRecord{}, e
		}
		if !ok || v.Value.Actor != actor {
			return cellworld.OwnerRecord{}, errors.New("missing actor grant")
		}
		return v.Value, nil
	}
	first, err := read()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if first.Entry == 0 || first.Grant.Process.SID != 1001 || first.Phase != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("initial grant: %+v", first)
	}
	start := b.snapshot()[actor].pos()
	if err := fullReady(ctx, audit, a, b, actor, bid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	step("initial", map[string]any{"at": time.Now().UTC(), "A_player": a.playerID, "B_player": b.playerID, "A_actor": actor, "B_actor": bid, "pos": start, "grant": first, "grace": reconnectGrace.String()})
	moveAt := time.Now()
	if err := a.moveIntent(ctx, 120, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var grant cellworld.OwnerRecord
	var sawFrozen bool
	var lastSource, grantAt, cut time.Time
	var movingOnB object
	// Close as soon as we observe an active grant on the destination, not after walkTo (sends stop).
	for time.Since(moveAt) < 5*time.Second {
		g, e := read()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		t := time.Now()
		if g.Phase == 2 {
			sawFrozen = true
		}
		if g.Grant.Process.SID == 1001 {
			lastSource = t
			if o, ok := b.snapshot()[actor]; ok && o.pos().X > start.X && o.updated.After(moveAt) {
				movingOnB = o
			}
		}
		if g.Phase == 1 && g.Grant.Process.SID == 1002 {
			grant = g
			grantAt = t
			cut = time.Now()
			if e = a.raw.Close(); e != nil {
				return e
			}
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(7 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if cut.IsZero() || grant.Entry != first.Entry || grant.Grant.Epoch <= first.Grant.Epoch {
		return fmt.Errorf("no same-entry handoff 1001 -> 1002: %+v", grant)
	}
	if movingOnB.updated.IsZero() {
		return errors.New("no B wire displacement before handoff and TCP close")
	}
	step("handoff_close", map[string]any{"move_at": moveAt.UTC(), "B_saw_moving_at": movingOnB.updated.UTC(), "B_pre_cut_pos": movingOnB.pos(), "last_source_sample": lastSource.UTC(), "destination_sample": grantAt.UTC(), "tcp_close_start": cut.UTC(), "after_grant_us": cut.Sub(grantAt).Microseconds(), "sampled_frozen_before_cut": sawFrozen, "cut_inside_frozen_window": false, "client_sent_stop": false, "grant": grant})
	row := func() (map[string]any, error) {
		rows, e := cellEntities(ctx, 1002)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		for _, r := range rows {
			if asInt(r["id"]) == actor && r["role"] == "real" && asInt(r["epoch"]) == int64(grant.Grant.Epoch) {
				return r, nil
			}
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no matching real for %d", actor)
	}
	var parked point
	var samples []map[string]any
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if i > 0 {
			time.Sleep(350 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		if err = waitFor(ctx, 2*time.Second, "destination Real stopped away from an edge, B agrees", func() (bool, string) {
			r, e := row()
			if e != nil {
				return false, e.Error()
			}
			p := point{asInt(r["x"]), asInt(r["y"])}
			o, ok := b.snapshot()[actor]
			vx, hasX := r["vx"]
			vy, hasY := r["vy"]
			if !ok || !hasX || !hasY || asInt(vx) != 0 || asInt(vy) != 0 || p.X <= boundary || p.X >= boundary+100 || p.Y != start.Y || o.pos() != p || (i > 0 && p != parked) {
				return false, fmt.Sprintf("cell=%v B=%v previous=%v", r, o.pos(), parked)
			}
			parked = p
			samples = append(samples, map[string]any{"at": time.Now().UTC(), "B_pos": o.pos(), "cell": r})
			return true, ""
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	retained := func(label string) error {
		g, e := read()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if g != grant {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: grant changed %+v -> %+v", label, grant, g)
		}
		if err := health(b); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if cnt := b.createCount(actor); cnt != 1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: B saw %d creates", label, cnt)
		}
		if _, removed := b.removedAt(a.playerID, moveAt); removed {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: B saw premature remove", label)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := retained("parked"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	step("stopped_offline", map[string]any{"samples": samples, "B_frames": frameCount(b), "B_creates": b.createCount(actor), "B_removes": 0})
	a2, err := dial("walker", "A2")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer a2.raw.Close()
	if time.Since(cut) >= *reconnectGrace || a2.playerID != a.playerID {
		return fmt.Errorf("not same-player reconnect within grace: %s", time.Since(cut))
	}
	if err = fullReady(ctx, audit, a2, b, actor, bid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = retained("short reconnect"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	step("short_reconnect", map[string]any{"elapsed_ms": time.Since(cut).Milliseconds(), "grant": grant, "B_creates": b.createCount(actor), "B_removes": 0})
	hp0, hitDamage := b.snapshot()[bid].hp(), attackOf(a2)
	payload := must(pb.MarshalAttackTargetRequest(&pb.AttackTargetRequest{Target: bid, RequestID: 11}))
	hit, err := a2.numberedAttack(ctx, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = presentOn(ctx, b, bid, func(o object) bool { return o.hp() == hp0-hitDamage }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = waitFor(ctx, 3*time.Second, "one applied push", func() (bool, string) {
		p := a2.resultsFor(hit.Seq, hit.Seq)
		return len(p) == 1 && p[0].AttackID == hit.AttackID && p[0].Outcome == "applied" && int64(p[0].Damage) == hitDamage && int64(p[0].TargetHP) == hp0-hitDamage, fmt.Sprint(p)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	a3, err := dial("walker", "A3")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer a3.raw.Close()
	if err = fullReady(ctx, audit, a3, b, actor, bid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = retained("overlap"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// All requests below are ordinary documented requests on A's own, previously admitted socket.
	stale := map[string]int32{}
	want := int32(100905)
	type request struct {
		name   string
		id     uint32
		data   []byte
		decode func([]byte) (int32, error)
	}
	for _, r := range []request{
		{"move", msgid.MsgMoveIntent, must(pb.MarshalMoveIntentRequest(&pb.MoveIntentRequest{VX: -110})), func(b []byte) (int32, error) {
			r, e := pb.UnmarshalMoveIntentResponse(b)
			if e != nil {
				return 0, e
			}
			return r.Code, nil
		}},
		{"attack", msgid.MsgAttackTarget, must(pb.MarshalAttackTargetRequest(&pb.AttackTargetRequest{Target: bid, RequestID: 12})), func(b []byte) (int32, error) {
			r, e := pb.UnmarshalAttackTargetResponse(b)
			if e != nil {
				return 0, e
			}
			return r.Code, nil
		}},
		{"ready", msgid.MsgSceneReady, must(pb.MarshalSceneReadyRequest(&pb.SceneReadyRequest{})), func(b []byte) (int32, error) {
			r, e := pb.UnmarshalSceneReadyResponse(b)
			if e != nil {
				return 0, e
			}
			return r.Code, nil
		}},
		{"view", msgid.MsgSceneView, must(pb.MarshalSceneViewRequest(&pb.SceneViewRequest{ViewRadius: 120})), func(b []byte) (int32, error) {
			r, e := pb.UnmarshalSceneViewResponse(b)
			if e != nil {
				return 0, e
			}
			return r.Code, nil
		}},
	} {
		raw, e := a2.call(ctx, r.id, r.data)
		if e != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("old %s: %w", r.name, e)
		}
		code, e := r.decode(raw)
		if e != nil || code != want {
			return fmt.Errorf("old %s: code %d want %d (%v)", r.name, code, want, e)
		}
		stale[r.name] = code
	}
	retry, err := a3.numberedAttack(ctx, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if retry.AttackID != hit.AttackID || retry.Seq != hit.Seq {
		return fmt.Errorf("retry got another receipt %v vs %v", retry, hit)
	}
	if err = a3.moveIntent(ctx, 0, 60); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	before := b.snapshot()[actor].pos()
	oldClose := time.Now()
	if err = a2.raw.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = presentOn(ctx, b, actor, func(o object) bool { return o.pos().Y >= before.Y+18 && o.pos().X == parked.X }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = a3.moveIntent(ctx, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = retained("old close"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = health(a3); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if n := len(a2.resultsFor(hit.Seq, hit.Seq)) + len(a3.resultsFor(hit.Seq, hit.Seq)); n != 1 || b.snapshot()[bid].hp() != hp0-hitDamage {
		return fmt.Errorf("repeated verdict or damage: pushes=%d HP=%d", n, b.snapshot()[bid].hp())
	}
	step("overlap", map[string]any{"old_close": oldClose.UTC(), "rejected_on_previous_socket": stale, "old_receipt": hit, "new_socket_retry": retry, "target_hp": []int64{hp0, b.snapshot()[bid].hp()}, "damage_from_panel": hitDamage, "applied_push_count": 1, "B_observed_current_move": b.snapshot()[actor].pos(), "grant": grant})
	// Only the observer's TCP ObjectRemove counts as an exit. Also require a matching closed entry in Redis.
	off := time.Now()
	if err = a3.raw.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	time.Sleep(*reconnectGrace - 350*time.Millisecond)
	if err = retained("before expiry"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	audit.watch(actor, false)
	var gone time.Time
	var closed cellworld.OwnerRecord
	if err = waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "expiry: B removed and durable grant closed", func() (bool, string) {
		t, ok := b.removedAt(a.playerID, off)
		g, e := read()
		if e != nil {
			return false, e.Error()
		}
		gone, closed = t, g
		_, held := b.snapshot()[actor]
		return ok && !held && g.ClosedEntry == grant.Entry && g.Phase == 3, fmt.Sprintf("remove=%v grant=%+v", t, g)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if gone.Sub(off) < *reconnectGrace {
		return fmt.Errorf("wire removed at %s before grace %s", gone.Sub(off), *reconnectGrace)
	}
	if err = health(b); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	a4, err := dial("walker", "A4")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer a4.raw.Close()
	if err = fullReady(ctx, audit, a4, b, actor, bid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = presentOn(ctx, b, actor, func(o object) bool { return o.created.After(gone) }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fresh, err := read()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if fresh.Entry <= grant.Entry || fresh.ClosedEntry != grant.Entry || fresh.Phase != 1 || fresh.Actor != actor || fresh.Grant.Epoch <= grant.Grant.Epoch || b.createCount(actor) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid return: %+v, B creates %d", fresh, b.createCount(actor))
	}
	if err = health(b); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = health(a4); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rm := 0
	for _, r := range b.removalsSince(moveAt) {
		if r.ID == actor {
			rm++
		}
	}
	if rm != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("B saw %d removals, want one", rm)
	}
	step("expiry_return", map[string]any{"offline_at": off.UTC(), "B_wire_removed_at": gone.UTC(), "elapsed_ms": gone.Sub(off).Milliseconds(), "grace_ms": reconnectGrace.Milliseconds(), "closed": closed, "fresh": fresh, "B_frames": frameCount(b), "B_creates": b.createCount(actor), "B_removes": rm})
	return nil
}
